Borgus Elamin is an elven member of the Zhentarim visiting Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three. He is whispering to  Earspoon.
“
Hello. And goodbye.
„
— Borgus Elamin

Involvement

Act Three

Borgus and Earspoon are whispering to each other in the rear of Sharess' Caress. Approaching them triggers a passive  DC 15 History Check (with Rogues and Baldurians having advantage) and a  DC 10 Deception Check or  DC 15 Perception Check to determine they are talking about  Nine-Fingers Keene. The party can ask Earspoon where Nine-Fingers is by passing another ability check.
